ai_review.summary: Decent soundboard snippet with okay audio that captures a pretty good, short portion of the show.
ai_review.review: The recording is a brief excerpt that serves well as filler material; listeners note the sound quality as merely okay but acceptable. The performance itself is described as semi‑sweet and generally good, though no specific standout moments are called out.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one moderate (3‑star) review; the show is viewed as decent and the recording as merely okay, leading to an overall mid‑range rating with low confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Sound is described as 'ok' – clear enough for a short segment but not exceptional; no major flaws mentioned.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Short snippet that provides a pleasant, if brief, glimpse of the concert; good as filler alongside other material from the same venue.
